package.name: AI Bridge
package.description: Local bridge that lets an AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex CLI) work inside a running FreeCAD. The add-on starts a loopback-only HTTP JSON-RPC server; a stdlib MCP stdio server on the host proxies tool calls to it. Every mutating tool runs on the GUI thread inside its own transaction, so a single agent step is one undo. Nothing leaves the machine.

workbench.name: AI Bridge
workbench.description: Start/stop the local AI bridge server and copy the agent registration command.
